results.question: How many documents are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN count(d) AS documents LIMIT 1

results.question: How many people are in the knowledge graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS people

results.question: How many locatedIn relationships are there in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH ()-[:locatedIn]->() RETURN count(*) AS count LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct organizations are mentioned in cluster 4?
results.cypher: MATCH (:Document {cluster_id: 4})-[:mentions]->(o:Organization) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS organizations LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct people are mentioned in documents of cluster 19?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 19})-[:mentions]->(p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS people

results.question: How many documents from cluster 7 are in the graph?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 7}) RETURN count(d) AS count LIMIT 50

results.question: Which locations are mentioned in cluster 15?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 15})-[:mentions]->(l:Location) RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS location LIMIT 50

results.question: Which events are mentioned in cluster 12?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 12})-[:mentions]->(e:Event) RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS event_name LIMIT 50

results.question: How many distinct topics are the documents in cluster 6 about?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document {cluster_id: 6})-[:about]->(t:Topic) RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS topics

results.question: Which clusters have documents that mention nasa?
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'nasa' RETURN DISTINCT d.cluster_id AS cluster_id LIMIT 50

results.question: Which documents mention ibm?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'ibm' RETURN DISTINCT d.id
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'ibm' RETURN DISTINCT d.id LIMIT 50

results.question: How many documents mention israel?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'israel' RETURN count(DISTINCT d)
results.cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(e) WHERE e.name = 'israel' RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS count

results.question: Which organizations appear in both cluster 0 and cluster 18?
results.cypher: MATCH (d0:Document {cluster_id: 0})-[:mentions]->(o:Organization)<-[:mentions]-(d1:Document {cluster_id: 18}) RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS organization_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Which people are mentioned in more than one cluster?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person) WITH p, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 1 RETURN p.name
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(p:Person)
WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS cluster_count
WHERE cluster_count > 1
RETURN p.name AS person_name LIMIT 50

results.question: How many locations are mentioned in more than one cluster?
results.gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(l:Location) WITH l, count(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusters WHERE clusters > 1 RETURN count(l)
results.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:mentions]->(l:Location)
WITH l, COUNT(DISTINCT d.cluster_id) AS clusterCount
WHERE clusterCount > 1
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT l) AS locations
LIMIT 50

results.question: Which artifacts does microsoft produce?
results.cypher: MATCH (org:Organization {name: 'microsoft'})-[:produces]->(artifact:Artifact) RETURN artifact.name AS artifact_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Which people are affiliated with the fbi?
results.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:affiliatedWith]->(o:Organization {name: 'fbi'}) RETURN p.name AS person_name LIMIT 50

results.question: Which organizations are located in israel?
results.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization)-[:locatedIn]->(l:Location {name: 'israel'}) RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS organization LIMIT 50

results.question: How many organizations produce at least one artifact?
results.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization)-[:produces]->(a:Artifact) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS organizations

results.question: Which events take place in a location, and where?
results.cypher: MATCH (e:Event)-[:locatedIn]->(l:Location) RETURN e.name AS event, l.name AS location LIMIT 50
